$comment: Gate 24 measurements (tests/browser/first-paint-gate.browser.mjs) that fail for a reason outside the first paint, each with that reason, keyed by the case and the width it fails at («folder/case @width»); the same case at another width is counted. Reported by every run, not counted; an entry that passes again is reported under knownNowPassing and is taken out.

known.header-page/path-and-action @320: Fails at 320 only (1440, 1280 and 390 hold): a heading too long for its row beside the kept actions cannot be known before the code. At 320 «Каталог решений» with its star, ⋯ and «Создать» do not fit one line, so the folded row takes a line of its own under the heading when the code lays it (printed 116 -> 108). Whether they fit is the words' widths against the line, not a step of any width, and the host cannot query its own width before its code (ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-15-header-bare-tag, residual case; dispatcher decision for the GB7 refresh).
known.header-page/long-heading @390: Fails at 390 only (1440 holds): a heading without actions wraps whole (AS-3, sf-header-page 1.12.0), and how many lines it takes is the words' widths against the line, which the bare tag cannot know before its code: core.css keeps one heading line, the code lays the long example's two (60 -> 71). The printed first paint (the snapshot) holds at every width. ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-22-admin-shell-parts.
known.settings/large @390: Fails at 390 only (1440 and 1280 hold): in the rows look a choice whose options do not fit beside its name is a drill row (owner decision C176 (3)), measured by the code (choiceFits); at 1280 «Плотность» with «Плотно | Обычно» does not fit the 18rem panel in the desktop text (16 px) and is printed as a drill row, at 390 the phone text ladder (14 px) fits it and the code draws the choice in the row (243 -> 235). Whether it fits is the words' widths in the text ladder of the screen, which no rule of the sheet knows before the code (ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-19-first-paint-390, helper fp390; dispatcher to accept or ask the owner).

known.steps/install @390: Fails at 390 only (1440 and 1280 hold): layout auto is a row while the steps fit their own width on one line, else a column (owner decision C101 (4), sf-steps 1.4.0), and whether they fit is the labels' widths against the list's width in the phone's text ladder, measured by the code (checkFit); no rule of the sheet knows it before the code. The snapshot is printed at 1280, where the row fits; at 390 the code lays the column (28 -> 188).
